title: VFC gate off by default + three P0 fixes (Option C)
authority: owner-gm-authorised; VERIFIED_FOR_RELEASE; owner rulings on S4/waiver recorded; awaiting explicit commit authorisation
summary: Execute GM-approved Option C: gate the Form Layout Engine off by default, fix P0-1 (202 test rows in production), P0-2 (hide-control permission regression), P0-3 (section editor data loss), keep the backend, retire the Sections editor and tabbed-doctype support.

findings_in_scope.P0-1: RESOLVED 2026-11-12 - 202 _Test_* rows deleted under D3 conditions (backup + published row list + dry-run). Verified 210->8, 202->0, 8->8. ROOT CAUSE LATER FOUND AND FIXED: test_is_system_delete_guard and test_delete_layout_blocks_is_system create is_system=1 fixtures, and tearDown's bare 'except: pass' swallowed on_trash's refusal, leaking one row per run. tearDown now falls back to frappe.db.delete. Verified: full 51/51 run leaves profiles=8, _Test_=0, personal=0, test users=0.
findings_in_scope.P0-2: hide-control stripped by _restoreVisibleFieldWrapper - CONFIRMED REPRODUCED (A/B browser test). Permlevel case UNREACHABLE (Desk User auto-granted); hide_empty_read_only_fields case REPRODUCED (Frappe JSON default is 1, this site had it 0)
findings_in_scope.P0-3: RESOLVED - _mergeProfileWithNativeSections now only adopts fields absent from usedFields and never strips a user-placed field. Verified in-browser: new code keeps project_name in the user's section, reimplemented old algorithm moves it back to native (test discriminates).
findings_in_scope.P1-1: RESOLVED - narrow endpoint layout_api.save_my_native_layout(doctype) writes only the caller's own __native__ sentinel (signature is doctype-only, payload fixed). Revert button now calls it and reports conditionally. Root cause proven: save_layout + before_insert were both System Manager only, so no non-admin could ever create the personal row the resolver Step 1 and delete_my_personal_layout act on (0 personal profiles site-wide). Controller guard relaxed ONLY for a row scoped to the caller with is_default/is_system/for_role all clear; 4 negative-control tests assert shared profiles still blocked.
findings_in_scope.F3: Tabbed-doctype support - NOT REPRODUCED in browser (Project renders all 5 tabs). Recommend strike pending new evidence
findings_in_scope.D4: DONE 2026-11-12 - Sections editor (tab + pane + Add Section + dead branch) retired; Tab.prototype.refresh monkey-patch removed. Retiring the patch alone blanked tabbed forms (0/5 tabs visible), so tabbed-doctype support retired with it: attach now returns early for any doctype with a Tab Break. Revert control relocated from the retired Sections pane to the Layout pane so P1-1 survives.

S4.detail: D4 skips every doctype with a Tab Break, so VFC no longer applies to Project (4 tabs) and Task (2 tabs), both of which have enabled default profiles. No user is exposed to this today because enable_form_config ships OFF. Tabbed support is NOT to be revisited now; un-freezing the frontend is a Phase-2 decision the owner already deferred, and would be reconsidered then, without a prototype patch, only if the gate is ever enabled for a tabbed doctype.
S4.consequence: known_limitation, not a defect; no code change

waiver.detail: The waiver in FINAL_REVIEW.md section 8 existed because the AC-5/AC-6 coverage gap was real. Committed regressions now exist and were proven discriminating by both builder and verifier (verifier reproduced 4 fail / 7 pass against true pre-fix code from git show HEAD:). Waiving would discard evidence in favour of a weaker standard.
waiver.consequence: MAJOR-1 and MAJOR-2 closed on evidence, not waived
